fine_topics.name: Great Depression Recovery
fine_topics.definition: Federal and voluntary responses to the economic collapse of the 1930s, including relief, public works, and recovery measures.

fine_topics.name: Labor, Wages & Working Conditions
fine_topics.definition: Relations between labor and capital, the right to organize, wages and labor legislation, child labor, and urban tenement and social-welfare reform.

fine_topics.name: Welfare, Poverty & Economic Opportunity
fine_topics.definition: Anti-poverty programs, welfare reform to reward work, the minimum wage, and helping families toward self-sufficiency.

fine_topics.name: Prosperity, Jobs & the Middle Class
fine_topics.definition: Assessment of the nation's economic condition and appeals about jobs, growth, and security for working and middle-class families.

fine_topics.name: Trusts, Corporations & Antitrust
fine_topics.definition: Concern over concentrated corporate wealth and monopoly and proposals for federal supervision or regulation of interstate business.
